key.name: icon-size
key.description: Size of the icons drawn on the desktop.

key.name: icon-source
key.description: "type" draws the file type's own icon, so a .stl and a .obj look different from each other. "application" draws the icon of the program that opens the file, so changing the default program changes the icon. Either way a thumbnail wins where one exists.

key.name: show-hidden
key.description: Draw files whose name starts with a dot.

key.name: show-home
key.description: Draw an icon for the user's home folder.

key.name: show-trash
key.description: Draw an icon for the wastebasket, full or empty.

key.name: show-volumes
key.description: Draw an icon for each mounted drive.
